messages.english: Keep newer crop plans safe when an older app session saves its copy.
messages.translation: Vhulungani pulane ntswa dza zwimela dzi tshi tsireledzea musi sesheni ya kale ya app i tshi vhulunga khophi yayo.

messages.english: Review retained copies before continuing with your current crop plan.
messages.translation: Sedzulusani khophi dzo vhulungwaho ni sa athu bvela phanḓa na pulane yaṋu ya zwino ya zwimela.

messages.english: Retry interrupted guest crop transfers without replacing saved account work.
messages.translation: Lingedzani hafhu u fhirisela mushumo wa zwimela wa mueni wo thithiswaho hu si na u dzhia vhudzulo ha mushumo wa akhaunthu wo vhulungwaho.
Sedzulusani vhuvhulungelo ha pulane ya zwimela
Pulane ya mveledziso → Vhuvhulungelo ha pulane ya zwimela

messages.english: Check the storage notice. If an older session changed its copy, download both copies and review them before choosing to keep your current plan.
messages.translation: Sedzani nḓivhadzo ya vhuvhulungelo. Arali sesheni ya kale yo shandula khophi yayo, dzhenisani khophi dzoṱhe mbili ni dzi sedzuluse ni sa athu nanga u fara pulane yaṋu ya zwino.
